title: Hearing 'The Memphis Blues' from a circus parade
summary: At six or seven he hears a black band play 'The Memphis Blues' at the end of a circus parade and falls in love with music; later 'St. Louis Blues'.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Getting my first drums, with or without lessons

blocks.x: Before I go into that phase of my early life, I would like to mention the fact that when I was six or seven years old at one of those shows, I can remember it was a big circus. And they had a big brass band, and a big wagon drawn by horses. And the band was playing, and the elephants were marching. You know, you could see the wild animals in the cages of the wagons.

And on the end of the parade was a black band in a great big truck playing "The Memphis Blues." And I thought that was one of the most beautiful songs I had ever heard. "The Memphis Blues." From that time on it seems like music to me was magic. And every time there was a show in town, my father would always take me.
And as time went on another song came upon the horizon, "The St. Louis Blues." And I just fell in love with the "St. Louis Blues." It just seemed that the music was in my bones, and I just loved it.
